title: CBWA: training and evaluation pipeline for Class-Balance-Aware Weighted Aggregation
description: Code used for the experiments in T. Agarwal, C. Patil and S. Saman, 'Class-Balance-Aware Weighted Aggregation for Federated Pediatric Brain Tumor MRI Classification and Segmentation' (Results in Engineering, submitted): data preparation, federated training of FedAvg, FedProx and CBWA with a pretrained I3D model, evaluation and significance tests. Code only; no MRI data, masks, model weights or access tokens.
